mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1400K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1400K units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to lowered borrowing costs.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) drops below 3.2% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) shows a concurrent 3-month average increase of over 200K jobs, the combined signal of a tight labor market and strong job growth predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and stock performance
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60d are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances compared to non-triggered.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average, signaling strengthened supply chains, is expected to lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows no significant positive return difference (t-test p > 0.05) between triggered and non-triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth exceeding 3% on a year-over-year basis, indicating robust demand, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:GDP growth and historical market performance
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not positively correlated (Pearson's r > 0.3) with GDPC1 YoY growth rates in triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50 basis points within a 2-month window, signaling aggressive monetary easing, is expected to drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows a Rank IC below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and concurrently, RSAFS (retail and food services sales) shows a year-over-year increase of over 5%, the combined signal predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to strong consumer spending.
failure_condition: Triggered instances do not show significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) 5-day forward returns compared to non-triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on signal: the level of industrial production (INDPRO) being above its long-term (5-year) average is expected to contribute to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained supply chain efficiency.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis over 5 years shows a negative Rank IC, indicating no predictive power.
